name: Workspace audit
goal: Audit the sandboxed workspace and write a report describing what is stored where.

prompt.text: Explore the workspace with list_files, starting at '.' and descending into each top-level directory. Use file_info on anything that looks large. Produce an inventory: one section per top-level directory with file counts and notable files.

inspect.description: Look for stale or surprising content

report.description: Write the audit report into the workspace
